from kohakutpu.application.api.attention import attention

def facts():
    sizes = (1, 63, 64, 65, 197, 256)
    accepted = []
    for n in sizes:
        q = kp.tensor(np.zeros((3, n, 64), np.float16))
        k = kp.tensor(np.zeros((3, n, 64), np.float16))
        v = kp.tensor(np.zeros((3, 64, n), np.float16))
        y = attention(q, k, v)
        accepted.append(y.shape == (3, n, 64) and y.st.nbytes == 2*3*n*64)
    texts = [r.info['compiled'].traced.text for r in DEV.runs if r.name == 'attention_partial']
    return {'sizes': list(sizes), 'accepted': all(accepted), 'masked': bool(texts) and all('sel ' in t and '-inf' in t for t in texts)}
